data_page.quote: There are about 120 tasks in the test set, evenly divided between the public and private splits.

rules_ties.quote: In the event of a tie, the Submission that was entered first to the Competition will be the winner.

rules_final.quote: You may select up to two (2) Final Submissions for judging.

rules_boards.quote: The Public Leaderboard will be based on the public test set and the Private Leaderboard will be based on the private test set.

sources.read: competition pages read through the Kaggle API (kaggle competitions pages --content) on the census day

scores: per-version public scores from each notebook's public version history
files_sha256: sha256 of json.dumps(FILES, sort_keys=True); FILES = the dict of bundle paths -> text that the version's own code writes to submission.zip, resolved statically with ast (bundle_hash.py); nothing executed
